hypothesis: Keeping metadata reconstruction, tensor preparation, mask transitions, and request-level work separate should preserve the main control-flow distinctions while accommodating the expensive initial admission without a dedicated feature.

pcvs.name: batch_changed
pcvs.rationale: Separates fixed metadata reconstruction from unchanged-batch processing.

pcvs.expression: int(self.batch_update_builder.batch_changed) * (int(not self.all_greedy) + int(not self.no_top_p) + int(not self.no_top_k) + 4 * int(not self.no_penalties) + int(not self.no_allowed_token_ids))
pcvs.name: tensor_preparation_paths
pcvs.rationale: Counts sampling copies and, for penalties, three copies plus prompt-tensor construction.

pcvs.expression: int(len([ids for ids in self.req_output_token_ids if ids is not None and len(ids) <= 1]) > 0) + int(bool(self.batch_update_builder.added) and self.all_greedy)
pcvs.name: mask_transition_work
pcvs.rationale: Combines minimum-token transitions with the additional fixed work observed during all-greedy admission.

pcvs.expression: len(self.batch_update_builder.added) + 2 * int(bool(self.batch_update_builder.added)) + (self.num_reqs if self.batch_update_builder.batch_changed and (not self.no_penalties) else 0)
pcvs.name: request_preparation_work
pcvs.rationale: Represents admission setup, per-request initialization, and prompt-padding iterations.
